description: Audit a token's decoded header and claim set against the contract a relying party needs. Reports an unsigned or symmetric algorithm, a header naming the key it should be verified with, an absent expiry, a lifetime beyond a stated bound, timestamps that contradict each other, and a missing issuer or audience, where any service trusting the issuer accepts a token minted for a different one. Takes a decoded header and claims, never a token string. Pay 200000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

claims.description: The decoded claim set. Decode it locally, as above.

expected_audience.description: The audience the caller expects to find in aud.

expected_issuer.description: The issuer the caller expects, compared as an exact string because that is how a relying party compares it.

header.description: The decoded JOSE header. Decode it locally: a token string is a bearer credential and this product deliberately does not accept one.

max_lifetime_seconds.description: The longest acceptable exp minus iat. Defaults to 28800.

require_jti.description: Whether a jti is required, which is what lets a replayed token be recognised as a repeat. Defaults to false.

name: jwt_claim_contract_audit

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

contract_met.description: True only when nothing was found and nothing was left undecided.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

title: JWT Claim Contract Audit
